description: Rules for RAG Issue Golden E2E — researched public forges only. No customer secrets.
principle: Feed real repos → pick a real issue → ground-truth from issue body/title → RAG-DAG answer must cite and overlap ground truth. Soft-skip banned.

github_primary.why: Large issue corpus, stable API, GitHub Actions token works on free runners

github_secondary.why: Second forge surface; release/changelog style issues with long bodies

gitlab_primary.why: Public group API without auth for light project/issue topology

ground_truth.solution_brief: Issue title + body + node id + cite-only instruction
ground_truth.key_terms: alphanumeric tokens len>=3 minus english stopwords, top 40

question_template: Using only Private Brain graph evidence, what is the issue '{title}' about, and what should the solution approach be? Cite node ids with backticks.
